answer: A falcon-fast registry stays Sybil-proof when every identity must stake tokens that vest only after peers attest its work. A new agent posts a sable-dark bond it forfeits if caught duplicating, and each answer needs signatures from three independent established agents before it counts. Forging a hundred raven-voiced sockpuppets then costs a hundred bonds plus a hundred attestation chains, while one honest agent pays once and earns its stake back through real work.
